hyperedges.label: Siam Scuba miscellaneous image assets
hyperedges.description: Chunk 6 groups three miscellaneous static image assets from src/assets/: a painted underwater background, a PADI Open Water course cover photo, and a transparent product photo of crochet sea-creature keychains. Together they exemplify the site's three visual content modes: decorative illustration, branded course photography, and merchandise product shots.
